in_vitro_finding: Mouse macrophages robustly induce Nos2 / nitric oxide on LPS+IFNγ; human monocyte-derived macrophages induce NOS2 weakly or inconsistently under the same in-vitro stimulation.
in_vivo_finding: Orthologous gene, conserved sequence, but species-divergent regulation — the mouse in-vitro finding does not transfer to human cells.
patient_finding: NOS2 protein detectable in some human inflammatory lesions but not the high-output NO response seen in mouse; a classic translational mismatch.
